pub(crate) struct ParsedItem<'a, T>(pub(crate) &'a [u8], pub(crate) T);

contract.success: length >= N and each of the first N bytes is in the explicit ASCII decimal digit table
contract.value: mathematical positional decimal value of exactly N bytes; leading zeroes accepted
contract.remainder: saved input backing at byte offset N, length input.len()-N, exact suffix contents; one-past empty suffix for exact-length inputs
contract.failure: None; short and non-digit inputs perform no success arithmetic
contract.effects: input unchanged; no allocation or writes by the selected original methods; runner allocations are observation infrastructure
